task.description:
Write a test specification for EE-11 (State reconstruction). Create tests/specs/EE-11.md covering the following test cases:

1. Basic reconstruction — instance with N events: build an event log with N events (START_TOKEN, TASK_ACTIVATED, TASK_COMPLETED, etc.), call reconstructInstance, assert InstanceState equals persisted projection field-for-field (active tokens, variable map, task set, status).

2. Empty event log: call reconstructInstance on an instance with 0 events, assert returned state = initial state (ACTIVE, token on START, empty vars, empty tasks).

3. EXECUTION_ERROR in log: build an event log that ends with an EXECUTION_ERROR event, assert reconstructed status = ERROR.

4. Reconstruction spans events + events_archive: split events between the two tables (simulate archival by inserting some events into events_archive with lower sequence_numbers), call reconstructInstance, assert result is identical to reconstruction from events-only log.

5. NFR-04 performance: build an event log of 10,000 events (use a synthetic loop), measure wall-clock time of reconstructInstance, assert it completes in ≤5 seconds.

6. Write-back: call reconstructInstance with write_back=true, assert that instance_projections is updated with the reconstructed state.

7. POST /instances/{id}/reconstruct — HTTP 200: call the endpoint on a valid instance, assert HTTP 200 and correct InstanceState JSON body.

8. POST /instances/{id}/reconstruct — HTTP 404: call the endpoint on an instance with no events, assert HTTP 404.

9. Corrupt or absent projection: delete or corrupt the instance_projections row, call reconstructInstance, assert it still returns the correct InstanceState from the event log alone.

For each test case specify: preconditions, input, expected output, and which acceptance criterion it covers. Follow the format of existing spec files in tests/specs/.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/EE-11.md exists and covers all 9 test cases above
Each test case maps to at least one EE-11 acceptance criterion from docs/requirements/EE-11.md
NFR-04 test case clearly specifies the 10,000-event bound and 5-second deadline
Write-back test case covers the optional projection restore path
Spec is consistent with the reconstructInstance function design in engine.md

result.summary: Wrote EE-11 test specification (9 integration + 3 unit test cases) and reconstruction_test.zig structural unit tests; zig build test exits 0.
